Telangana CM Inaugurates EV Charging Hub and Road Works

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has inaugurated a high-speed TATA.ev MegaCharger Hub in Hyderabad. He also launched what is described as Telangana's biggest road works. Reddy stated that Telangana aims to become a hub for skilled employees in the country.
